design.singleAuthority: Project Studio uses the same Work OS project records and journal; new journal entry types PROJECT_REPOSITORY_SET and PROJECT_EXPORT_RECORDED; no second store.
design.managedRepository: <dataDir>/projects/<projectId>/repo; template repos are created under the journal lock after the idempotency check and before PROJECT_CREATED; initial commit by 'UASCO Project Studio <studio@local.invalid>' with isolated git.
design.import: git: clone --no-local --no-hardlinks with the runner's neutralised git env, origin removed; zip: stored/deflate only, all entries validated (traversal, symlink, special files, .git, names, duplicates, size, count, inflate cap, CRC) before any write; local absolute paths only.
design.devrun: fresh clone of repo HEAD as dev workspace, devCommand argv allow-list, safeChildEnv + free loopback PORT, single instance (map + devrun.lock), crash detection with exit code, process-tree kill, preview URL only after a real HTTP response, GLOBAL_STOP stops/blocks, orphan kill only when pid start time matches.
design.filesGit: lstat walk + realpath containment, symlink/junction refused, text only <= 512 KB, redaction; git log with run links; diff --no-textconv --no-ext-diff with empty attributes file, 512 KB cap; run commits read through GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES without writing to the managed repo.
design.export: git archive zip (source/, README.md, reports/*), built-in secret scan of every archived file before publishing (409 EXPORT_BLOCKED_SECRET), journaled evidence with sha256 and size, relative paths only.
design.executors: GET status READY|NOT_CONFIGURED|PROVENANCE_MISSING|CLI_NOT_FOUND, FAKE TEST_ONLY; enable runs scripts/capture-provider-provenance.mjs (version probes only) in the control root and persists <dataDir>/settings/executors.json; tests inject a fake capture; no model call anywhere.

findings.fix: core/workos/project-studio.ts: new managedRepoRoot(project) used by every files/file/git log/git diff/export operation (repoRoot) and by DevRunManager.start: requires repository.managed === true and realpath(repository.path) equal to realpath(<dataDir>/projects/<projectId>/repo) (case-insensitive on win32) and strictly under <dataDir>/projects; otherwise 409 REPOSITORY_NOT_MANAGED (missing path/dir stays 409 REPOSITORY_NOT_CONFIGURED). Defense in depth: new assertRepositoryPathAllowed(raw) rejects a client repository.path that resolves inside or above dataDir (same under(dataReal, real) || under(real, dataReal) test as localSource, on realpath and resolved path) and apps/control-api/src/server.ts POST /v1/projects calls it after the write gates: 400 REPOSITORY_PATH_FORBIDDEN.
tests: tests/v7-ps1a-c2-remediation.test.ts: PS1A-C1-F1 (tenant A cannot create projects pointing at <dataDir>, <dataDir>/projects, B project dir, B managed repo, a file in it, a path above dataDir or a non-existent path inside dataDir; journal-injected tA projects pointing at <dataDir>, <dataDir>/projects, an external non-managed repo, and a managed=true record pointing at B managed repo all get 409 REPOSITORY_NOT_MANAGED on files, file, git/log, git/diff, export, devrun/start, devrun/restart; no export zip written; B still reads its own repo)

findings.fix: core/workos/devrun.ts start(): after every await (owner start time / owner liveness, freePort, child startTimeOf) checks a.stopping || this.active.get(id) !== a || GLOBAL_STOP; before spawn it does not spawn (abortStart finalizes the entry as STOPPED if not yet finalized, releases the lock, returns the view, or throws 423 GLOBAL_STOP_ACTIVE when the stop file is active); after spawn it stops the child via stop() or awaits the exit already in progress. The port is assigned to state only after the check. cleanup() no longer overwrites persisted logs when no child was spawned. freePort is injectable (default freeLoopbackPort) to make the race deterministic in tests.
tests: tests/v7-ps1a-c2-remediation.test.ts: PS1A-C1-F2 (stopAll during the port wait -> STOPPED/GLOBAL_STOP_ACTIVE, pid null, port null, marker child never spawned, second stopAll finds 0, lock released; GLOBAL_STOP file activated during the port wait -> 423 and no spawn; stopAll during the post-spawn start-time await -> spawned child pid not alive; positive control: normal start spawns the marker child and close() stops it)

findings.fix: core/workos/devrun.ts: state records ownerStartTime (startTimeOf(process.pid), cached); ownerLive(state) treats another-process owner as live only when its pid is alive and the recorded start time matches (missing/unreadable start time on an alive pid stays fail-closed live; other host stays live). recover(), start() and takeLock() use it: a reused owner pid is not live, recover() reaps the orphan (child pid + start time still required to kill) and removes the lock only when the lock carries exactly that stale owner pid and instanceId; start() passes the same stale owner to takeLock. view() never returns an AVAILABLE preview/url read from the file when this instance has no active entry: masked to UNAVAILABLE with reason NOT_OWNED_BY_THIS_INSTANCE. ownerStartTime is not exposed in the public view.
tests: tests/v7-ps1a-c2-remediation.test.ts: PS1A-C1-F3 (live unrelated ownerPid with mismatching ownerStartTime -> ORPHAN_KILLED, unrelated process not killed, lock taken over, start 200, persisted ownerStartTime equals this process start time; genuinely live owner (pid + start time match) -> not recovered, preview masked NOT_OWNED_BY_THIS_INSTANCE, orphan untouched, start 409 DEVRUN_LOCKED; after that owner dies start 200)
